source_evidence.claim: Under the analytic bundle--module correspondence, rank-n holomorphic vector bundles with compatible G-action correspond to G-O-modules whose underlying O-module is locally isomorphic to O^n; the inverse bundle has fibre L_x tensor_{O_{X,x}} C through the residue map.

proof_obligations.claim: The section-sheaf functor is fully faithful.
proof_obligations.closure: In local trivializations, both holomorphic bundle maps and O-linear sheaf maps are exactly matrices of holomorphic functions.

proof_obligations.claim: Every locally free analytic module comes from a holomorphic vector bundle.
proof_obligations.closure: Local bases give GL_n(O)-valued transition matrices satisfying the cocycle identities, which glue trivial holomorphic bundles; evaluation of the same matrices gives the canonical fibre L_x tensor_{O_{X,x}} C.

proof_obligations.claim: The locally free analytic modules in the source are coherent.
proof_obligations.closure: Coherence is local and follows from Oka coherence; Grauert-direct-image p. 16 is pinned.

proof_obligations.claim: A compatible bundle action induces the exact G-O-module semilinearity used by Stacks.
proof_obligations.closure: The formula rho_g(s)(gx)=g(s(x)) gives the group law and rho_g(as)=rho_g(a)rho_g(s).

proof_obligations.claim: A locally free G-O-module reconstructs a compatible holomorphic bundle action.
proof_obligations.closure: In local bases the semilinear maps are invertible holomorphic matrices; basis changes and the group cocycle glue them to fibrewise-linear bundle maps over g.

proof_obligations.claim: The constructions form an equivalence of equivariant categories.
proof_obligations.closure: The nonequivariant full-faithfulness and the sectionwise group identities identify inverse objects and equivariant morphisms.
The candidate excludes extension classification, H^1, quotient descent, compactness, finite dimensionality, and GAGA.
